about: Safety presets (docs/design/blocking-and-safe-mode.md 10h, 2026-10-10). Read by both clients: the desktop app embeds this file (src/embedded_data.rs), the web chat fetches /data/gui/safety_presets.json. The words follow the dated finding docs/reference/findings/2026-10-10-childrens-online-safety-rules.md (section 6): never 'kid safe', 'child safe', 'compliant' or 'certified', and nothing here says the app or anyone in it is safe. If a sentence stops being true of the build that ships, it comes off the screen the same day.

presets.name: Protected setup
presets.summary: The protected setup locks these safety settings with a PIN on this device. It does not check anyone's age, and no setting can make an app, or the people in it, safe.
sentences: The protected setup locks these safety settings with a PIN on this device. It does not check anyone's age, and no setting can make an app, or the people in it, safe.
Warnings are simple checks for known patterns, run on this device only. They miss things. They never send your messages to anyone and never report anything.
Nothing about this setup is sent to any server. The server does not know this device is protected.
Messages are end-to-end encrypted. Nobody, including server admins, can read them to look for danger.
Anyone can make a new identity for free. Blocking stops that identity; letting only friends message this device stops everyone who is not a friend.
This lock protects the settings in this app on this device. It does not stop another app, another browser or another device. Your computer's or phone's own family controls can.
No regulator or outside body has reviewed HumanityOS under any children's privacy or online safety law. Our dated research notes are public.
presets.review_intro: These can already reach this device. Remove anyone you do not want here; the rest stay.
presets.status_line: The protected setup is on: only friends can message you, and adding a friend needs the PIN.
presets.routes_line: With it on, only friends you approved can send direct messages, and adding a friend, joining a group or joining a voice room needs the PIN. Read-only rooms stay visible, and the server's admins can still send notices.
presets.public_rooms_hidden_line: Public rooms are hidden by the protected setup.
presets.public_rooms_explain: Public rooms are public: anyone on that server can post there.
presets.picture_hidden_line: A picture or file from someone who is not a friend is not shown.
presets.forgot_pin_explain: Whoever keeps the recovery phrase can change the PIN. Keep the recovery phrase away from the person this protects.
